digest.component_or_area: bug prevention program: observability, gates, migrations, skill discipline
propositions: Bug provenance must be observable at creation and queryable via bug_trends metrics without requiring new user input.

Deterministic pre-LLM CI gates must block: raw git writes bypassing store, unread config fields, unbounded wall-clock asserts in tests, incomplete AC checkboxes at close, code comments with dead references, and oversized bug fixes lacking plan-review attestation.
Reconciler transport requires end-to-end typing with property-test pinning of declared asymmetries and deduplicated pagination into a shared cursor iterator.
Production shell logic in reconcile-bridge, canary workflows, probe harness, and vote normalizer must migrate to Python per strangler-fig policy.
Code comments referencing dead SHAs, run-ids, or dates must be remediated to ticket citations, with CI guard preventing regression.

A completion attestation signing defect in compute_validity caused pre-330c children to silently skip attestation; grandfathering legacy non-normalized hashes restores certifiable state for affected epic children.
